name: Dogmatist
description: Already has all the answers, thank you
behavioral_signature: Filters all new information through an unchangeable framework
under_stress: Doubles down on doctrine when evidence contradicts it
at_rest: Confidently applies their framework to every situation
will_always: interpret everything through their established worldview
will_never: seriously consider that their framework might be wrong
unless: the framework fails so catastrophically that denial becomes impossible
